Hi Olivia / Rishi —

A couple of operational notes from our side so your portal ingestion doesn't block payment:

- Invoice header must include: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Redwood Purchase Order (PO#), Redwood Tax ID (EIN/TIN), and the remit-to bank name exactly as provided. If your portal splits 'Reference' vs 'PO Number' please ensure PO shows in the PO Number field.
- We require invoices to reference the issuing PO in both the human readable area and the exported metadata (CSV or XML). Example field name we commonly see: "customer_po_number" or "CustomerPO".
- If you use EDI/UBL, please include the <BuyerReference> or <CustomerPO> element.
- For early-payment programs (if you offer term discounts) we need the discount terms on the invoice and a separate PO amendment.

I've included a short sample invoice (redwood_invoice_sample.pdf) showing our preferred layout.

Olivia, could you also confirm whether StellarCharge's portal supports a secondary contact email for remittance advices? We can subscribe to an AP webhook if available to signal invoice receipt.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
